meta.name: distill
meta.description: Strip designs to their essence by removing unnecessary complexity. Great design is simple, powerful, and clean.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化设计,去除多余元素
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望设计更简洁有力
copy.tagline_en: Simplify designs by removing unnecessary elements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want cleaner, more powerful designs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的设计或功能，找出不必要的复杂元素，然后提出简化方案，包括减少颜色、字体、按钮数量，合并重复内容，隐藏次要功能，让界面更清晰、操作更直接。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 简化某个设计、功能或界面时触发。它会在开始前先确认目标用户和核心用途，如果信息不足会主动提问。

say.text: 帮我简化这个注册页面，去掉不必要的字段。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并给出精简后的布局和文案。

say.text: 这个仪表盘太乱了，帮我提炼出最重要的三个指标。
say.note: Claude 会识别核心数据，隐藏次要信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your design or feature, identifies unnecessary complexity, and proposes simplifications such as reducing colors, fonts, buttons, merging duplicate content, and hiding secondary functions to make the interface clearer and more direct.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to simplify a design, feature, or interface. It first gathers context about target users and core purpose, and asks clarifying questions if information is insufficient.

say_en.text: Simplify this signup page, remove unnecessary fields.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest a streamlined layout and copy.

say_en.text: This dashboard is cluttered, distill it to the top three metrics.
say_en.note: Claude will identify core data and hide secondary info.
